explanatory_strength.rationale: Inversion still works: workflow moat, RPO, and cash conversion are hard to fake; AI seat-churn and RPO lag are named falsifiers. Round two does not weaken the explanatory map.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: Research loop confirmed the widest gaps (cohort seats, Firefly attach, segment FCF) remain unresolved. Sufficient to reject fantasy IRRs; insufficient to claim circle-of-competence certainty on AI defense.

downside_control.rationale: Cash and recurring revenue limit ruin. Equity can still lose roughly half to contract low if the AI narrative fails. Partial dhando only.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: Contract ~15.8% versus Lawrence ~32% remains too wide. Prefer the capitalization proof; do not average into the higher figure.

claims.claim: At $234.74, contract base $656/sh implies ~15.81% annualized versus Lawrence synthesis ~32%, a methodological gap that round two still refuses to average away.
Research response leaves net seat additions and Firefly attach unresolved; those remain the critical moat tests.

strongest_counter_explanation: Adobe's distribution and creative standard are hard to displace; unresolved cohort metrics overstate competitive risk relative to RPO and H1 momentum.
most_important_missing_fact: Digital Media net new seats and generative-AI attach by cohort from a primary disclosure or management session.
falsifiers: Two consecutive quarters of RPO growth below revenue growth
Sustained Digital Media net new ARR decline with documented competitor seat wins
specialist_findings: Munger round two: stay inverted. Watch. Primary method should be contract capitalization with AI reserve, not Lawrence growth synthesis.
